purpose: Fictional DEMO pharmacy catalog photography for Klini Mobile. No real brands or therapeutic claims.

reference.role: Visual style and product-composition reference only; the UI screenshot was inspected, not edited.

verification.method: Visual inspection of all four generated outputs and PNG decoding using the existing project pngjs package.
verification.renderingRecommendation: Use contain to preserve each complete product silhouette; use a larger hero area for the sunscreen and product-sized areas for catalog items.
verification.note: Native generated alpha, semitransparent edges and subtle shadows preserved.

Asset type: independent transparent PNG product photograph for a premium mobile DEMO pharmacy catalog.
Primary request: one fictional white 50 mL sunscreen squeeze tube with a pale mint-green cap at the bottom and two restrained mint bands near the lower third. The closed tube leans slightly, approximately 10 degrees, and is fully visible.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent alpha background, no backdrop or floor plane. Include only a very subtle isolated contact shadow that fades to full transparency.

Composition/framing: square canvas, product centered, full silhouette including cap and sealed top, generous clear padding, viewed at a slight three-quarter angle. Keep the entire tube sharp and crisp, suitable for display at small mobile size.
